numbers.label: Number 91
numbers.instruction: Show the '9' base handshape (tip of the thumb touching the tip of the index finger while middle, ring, and pinky remain upright), then transition to an extended index finger ('1').

numbers.label: Number 92
numbers.instruction: Start with the '9' base, then extend the index and middle fingers ('2') while curling the remaining fingers.

numbers.label: Number 93
numbers.instruction: Start with the '9' base, then extend the thumb, index, and middle fingers ('3').

numbers.label: Number 94
numbers.instruction: Start with the '9' base, then extend 4 upright fingers ('4') with the thumb folded flat against the palm (no active pinch contact).

numbers.label: Number 95
numbers.instruction: Start with the '9' base, then open all 5 fingers fully and loosely ('5').

numbers.label: Number 96
numbers.instruction: Start with the '9' base, then shift the thumb to contact the tip of the pinky finger ('6' pinch) while index, middle, and ring fingers remain upright.

numbers.label: Number 97
numbers.instruction: Start with the '9' base, then shift the thumb to contact the tip of the ring finger ('7' pinch) while index, middle, and pinky remain upright.

numbers.label: Number 98
numbers.instruction: Start with the '9' base, then shift the thumb to contact the tip of the middle finger ('8' pinch) while index, ring, and pinky remain upright.

numbers.label: Number 99
numbers.instruction: Hold the '9' handshape (thumb touching index finger) and perform two distinct outward/forward pulses or bounces.

numbers.label: Number 100
numbers.instruction: Start with an upright extended index finger ('1'), then slide slightly outward and curve your entire hand into an open 'C' shape (Roman numeral C = 100).
